_about: A class's passive features as documents (rules/classfeatures.py), keyed by the slug of
the grant on the class table. Read live; nothing is stored on a sheet. Rules from the
Core Rulebook fighter, checked against d20pfsrd.com/classes/core-classes/fighter and

bravery.name: Bravery
bravery.source: CRB, Fighter: "Starting at 2nd level, a fighter gains a +1 bonus on Will saves against fear. This bonus increases by +1 for every four levels beyond 2nd." The table's rungs carry it (+1 ... +5).
not_yet: against: fear — no save yet says it is against fear (spell saves pass only "spell"), so the term is dropped, never applied

armor-training.name: Armour training
armor-training.source: CRB, Fighter: "Whenever he is wearing armor, he reduces the armor check penalty by 1 (to a minimum of 0) and increases the maximum Dexterity bonus allowed by his armor by 1. Every four levels thereafter (7th, 11th, and 15th), these bonuses increase by +1 each time ... In addition, a fighter can also move at his normal speed while wearing medium armor. At 7th level, a fighter can move at his normal speed while wearing heavy armor." The table's rungs are 1 ... 4.

weapon-training.name: Weapon training
weapon-training.source: CRB, Fighter: "Starting at 5th level, a fighter can select one group of weapons ... Whenever he attacks with a weapon from this group, he gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls. Every four levels thereafter (9th, 13th, and 17th), a fighter becomes further trained in another group of weapons. He gains a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls when using a weapon from this group. In addition, the bonuses granted by previous weapon groups increase by +1 each." So the first group picked is +rank and the last +1: picks - index. "If a weapon is found in two or more different groups, these bonuses do not stack. Take the highest bonus granted for that weapon" — the bonus type is named so the funnel takes the best.
not_yet: the bonus on combat maneuver checks made with a weapon of the group, and to CMD against disarm and sunder: the manoeuvre roll does not say which weapon makes it
the picks themselves: the class-choice writer is lane 1's (docs/class-audit.md §8); read through classfeatures.chosen

armor-mastery.name: Armour mastery
armor-mastery.source: CRB, Fighter: "At 19th level, a fighter gains damage reduction 5/— whenever he is wearing armor or using a shield."
